local function interp(P, x)
  if x <= P[1][1] then return P[1][2] end
  for i=1,#P-1 do local a,b=P[i],P[i+1]
    if x>=a[1] and x<=b[1] then return a[2]+(b[2]-a[2])*(x-a[1])/(b[1]-a[1]) end end
  return P[#P][2]
end
